text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Belgium hopes to resume diplomatic ties with Baghdad soon.
- Sudan supports President Saddam Hussein's initiative to hold an Arab summit to discuss the Palestinian issue which he declared in his speech marking the July 17 revolution.
- Italian police arrest Iraqi Kurds who tried to enter Italy illegally.
- Iraqi oil ministry to hold July 29 conference that will discuss the impact of oil industry on environment.
(The above were also carried by IRAQ and THAWRA)
- Editorial attacking British government for statements made by member of the government against Iraq.
